export_compensation.summary: Solar Choice program structures export compensation.

interconnection.typical_size_notes: Residential rooftop systems are typically under 25–30 kW. Confirm thresholds with the utility.
interconnection.pto_notes: Permission to Operate usually follows municipal final inspection and utility review. Do not export until PTO is granted.

steps.title: Interconnection application
steps.body: Your installer submits equipment specs and a one-line diagram to Dominion Energy SC for hosting-capacity / engineering review before or during construction.

steps.title: Local AHJ permitting & construction
steps.body: City/county building and electrical permits are separate from utility approval. Permit timelines vary by municipality (often 2–8 weeks).

steps.title: Municipal electrical inspection
steps.body: A local inspector verifies NEC / rapid-shutdown compliance. Passing this inspection is required before utility PTO.

steps.title: Permission to Operate (PTO)
steps.body: Dominion Energy SC reviews documentation, configures metering, and issues PTO. Only then can you legally energize export.

local_permitting_notes: Local AHJ timelines vary widely (SolarAPP+ in some CA cities vs multi-week manual review elsewhere). Confirm with your city/county before signing.
headline: Is solar worth it with Dominion Energy SC in 2026?
summary: Solar Choice program structures export compensation. Model your address with transparent assumptions — the 30% federal residential tax credit (25D) no longer applies to systems placed in service after Dec 31, 2025.

sections.heading: Why Dominion Energy SC customers research solar
sections.body: Homeowners usually start after a bill spike, rate notice, or neighbor install — then hit conflicting quotes. In 2026, cash/loan buyers cannot rely on the expired federal 25D credit. Payback depends on your utility’s export rules, state programs, and whether a battery or third-party ownership structure is part of the deal.

sections.heading: Export compensation & interconnection
sections.body: Solar Choice program structures export compensation. Interconnection still requires utility review after the municipal electrical inspection. Treat Permission to Operate as a separate gate from the city final.

sections.heading: What to do before a sales appointment
sections.body: Pull recent bills, note your rate schedule, and model your roof at your address. Ask every quote to show cash price, $/W, export/self-consumption assumptions, and whether any state production incentive is included.

faqs.question: Does the federal solar tax credit still apply for Dominion Energy SC customers in 2026?
faqs.answer: For homeowner-owned cash or loan purchases placed in service after Dec 31, 2025, Section 25D is generally $0. Some leases/PPAs may still reflect commercial credits — get that in writing. Not tax advice.

faqs.question: How do I evaluate a solar quote in Dominion Energy SC territory?
faqs.answer: Normalize to $/W before incentives, separate batteries, and pressure-test savings against your bill’s rate and this utility’s export regime — not a national average.

open_questions: Confirm official interconnection portal URL and 2026 tariff details from utility primary sources.
